title: Q2 Results Live 27th Oct: ACC, Mazagon Dock Q2 profit tumbles, Bharat Bijlee & Bharat Seats rally, Cipla profit declines 35%, L&T, Maruti Suzuki, Bajaj Auto, Vedanta Iron, Waaree Energies, SAIL, SBI L
text:
Two investors are working together with analyzing the stock data graphs in the paper and viewing the data on the laptop screen. | Photo Credit: wutwhanfoto

Q2 Results Today, 27th October 2026 Live Updates: Find all the latest Q2 results 2026 updates of Larsen & Toubro, Maruti Suzuki India, Bajaj Auto, Cipla, Tata Steel, Vedanta Iron And Steel, Waaree Energies, Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders, ACC, JSW Infrastructure, JSW Cement, Steel Authority of India, Tata Capital, SBI Life Insurance Company, Max Financial Services.

GAINERS: Tata Consumer, Paytm, Sona BLW, ITC Hotels, BOM, KFin Tech, Ather Energy

Stock market live updates | Stay tuned to businessline for more

ACC: Standalone profit tumbles to ₹101 crore in Q2

Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders’ standalone net profit tumbles ₹340.20 cr

Radico Khaitan: Logs 66% y-o-y increase in standalone net profit at ₹230.87 cr

Bharat Bijlee: Standalone PAT at ₹46.04 cr

Transport Corporation of India’s standalone net profit dipped to Rs 91.7 crore in Q2FY27 compared to Rs 87.8 crore in Q2FY26.

Board approved issuance of NCDs aggregating to Rs 300 crore; and approved the appointment of Mr. Bhudev Bhushan Giri as CEO – Designate, TCI Seaways Division and Senior Management Personnel of the Company.

Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders’ standalone net profit tumbled to Rs 340.20 crore in Q2FY27 as against Rs 715.37 crore in Q2FY26.

Declared interim dividend of Rs 5 per share.

Board approved increase in authorised share capital of the ocmpnay to Rs 900 crore.

Shares fell over 6% to Rs 1752 on the NSE.

ACC posted standalone net profit of Rs 101 crore in Q2FY27 as against Rs 1,112 crore in Q2FY26.

Shares down about 4% to Rs 1,123.30 on the NSE.

“We are pleased to report sustained strong growth momentum in Q2 FY27, with revenue growing by 24% YoY,and EBITDA growing by 51% YoY, reflecting disciplined execution across our businesses. Our quarterly EBITDAhas more than doubled in three years, reflecting the successful execution of our Pinnacle strategy and disciplinedcost management. This momentum was also reflected in our strong H1 performance, with revenue increasing by25% and EBITDA by 44%.We are delighted to have signed an agreement to acquire a 40% stake in ZettaOne Technologies Limited,marking our entry into the EDMS space, which will help us in offering an integrated value proposition to ourcustomers in Electronics/Semicon sectors”.

Huhtamaki India reported PAT of Rs 29.7 crore in Q2FY27 against Rs 36.7 crore in Q2DY26.

Shares tank over 10% to Rs 193.96 on the NSE.

Radico Khaitan reported 66% y-o-y increase in standalone net profit of Rs 230.87 crore in Q2FY27 compared to Rs 138.95 crore in Q2FY26.

Century Enka reported 21% y-o-y decline in standalone net profit for the quarter ended September 2026 at Rs 18.64 crore against Rs 22.56 crore in Q2FY26.

Shares traded 7% lower at Rs 476.20 on the NSE.

Jubilant Ingrevia reported standalone PAT of Rs 70.40 crore in Q2FY27 compared to Rs 126.22 crore in June 2026 quarter and Rs 44.03 crore in Q2FY26.

Shares traded 6% higher at Rs 643.70 on the NSE.

Bharat Bijlee reported standalone PAT of Rs 46.04 crore in Q2FY27 as against Rs 28.23 crore in Q2FY26.

Shares jumped 16% to Rs 2,611.70 on the NSE.

“We are pleased to share that we continue to make considerable progress across our focused markets. InQ2FY27, we delivered global revenues of INR 7,404 Cr with a sequential growth of 4% QoQ, while EBITDAmargin expanded by 200 basis points QoQ to 18.7%. Our One-India business grew at solid 12% YoY. BrandedPrescription business delivered a robust growth, with key therapies outpacing the market. The U.S. businessposted revenue of $ 172 Mn during the quarter, continuing its sequential growth trajectory. We expect NorthAmerica performance to remain supported by our upcoming product pipeline. South Africa private marketbusiness continued to outperform the market, growing approximately 1.3x faster than the market. We continueto focus on sustained growth in our core businesses, improving productivity, strengthening our pipeline in orderto serve patients with trusted, high-quality medicines”

Achin Gupta MD and Global CEO, Cipla Ltd

Kirloskar Pneumatic Company’s standalone net profit dipped 7.8% to Rs 39.8 crore in Q2FY27 as against Rs 43.2 crore in Q2FY26.

Shares traded 8% lower at Rs 546.50 on the NSE.

Morepen Laboratories posted net profit of Rs 88.89 crore in Q2FY27 as agianst Rs 41.04 crore in Q2FY26.

Shares hit upper circuit on the NSE at Rs 132.31, 5% higher.

Bharat Seats reported net profit of Rs 15.20 crore in Q2FY27 as against Rs 9.90 crore in Q2FY26.

Board approved the investment in the equity shares of a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV), amounting to Rs. 99 Lakhs, in one or more tranches, for sourcing power through captive solar power energy

Shares jumped over 11% to Rs 206 on the NSE.

Cipla reported standalone PAT of Rs 787.03 crore in Q2FY27, down 34.9% from Rs 1,210.53 crore recorded in Q2FY26.

SKY GOLD AND DIAMONDS posted 55.6% y-o-y increase in standalone net profit of Rs 85.37 crore in Q2FY27.

Board approved raising of funds not exceeding Rs 1,800 crore through QIP.

Sterling Tools’ standalone net profit declined to Rs 13.63 crore in Q2FY27 as against Rs 19.79 crore in Q2FY26.

Board has appointed Amit Dhadda as the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) following the resignation of Anish Agarwal.

Nazara Technologies had reported a profit after tax of about Rs 35.3 crore for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, against a loss of about Rs 34 crore in the year-ago period,

Shares traded flat at Rs 400.95 on the NSE.

Tamilnad Mercantile Bank shares erased early gains, trading at Rs 787.30 on the NSE at 12.20 pm after hitting an intraday high of Rs 828.60.

It posted its highest-ever quarterly net profit of ₹451 crore in Q2FY27.

Bank of Maharashtra traded 2% positive at Rs 77.93 on the NSE at 12.12 pm, after rising to Rs 80.50. It reported a 41 per cent year-on-year (yoy) jump in second quarter net profit at ₹2,310 c
